Assembly Evaluation Summary

Bailey Jannuzzi

Overview

This document summarizes the assembly quality of 13 Salmonella enterica genomes downloaded from NCBI. Quality is assessed across the three C’s:

  • Completeness — assessed with BUSCO v6.0.0 using the bacteria_odb10 lineage
  • Contiguity — assessed with QUAST using default parameters
  • Correctness — With no reference genome being used, this metric has yet to be assessed

Parse BUSCO Results

busco_dir <- "/home/bailey/Desktop/binf_capstone/assembly_evaluation/busco_output"

parse_busco <- function(filepath) {
  lines  <- readLines(filepath)
  sample <- basename(dirname(filepath))
  sample <- str_remove(sample, "_genomic_busco$")

  busco_line <- lines[grep("^\\s+C:", lines)]

  data.frame(
    Sample           = sample,
    BUSCO_Complete   = as.numeric(str_match(busco_line, "C:(\\d+\\.\\d+)%")[,2]),
    BUSCO_Single     = as.numeric(str_match(busco_line, "S:(\\d+\\.\\d+)%")[,2]),
    BUSCO_Duplicated = as.numeric(str_match(busco_line, "D:(\\d+\\.\\d+)%")[,2]),
    BUSCO_Fragmented = as.numeric(str_match(busco_line, "F:(\\d+\\.\\d+)%")[,2]),
    BUSCO_Missing    = as.numeric(str_match(busco_line, "M:(\\d+\\.\\d+)%")[,2])
  )
}

busco_files <- list.files(busco_dir, pattern = "short_summary.*\\.txt",
                          recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

busco_files <- busco_files[str_count(busco_files, "/") == str_count(busco_dir, "/") + 2]
busco_df <- bind_rows(lapply(busco_files, parse_busco))

Parse QUAST Results

quast_dir <- "/home/bailey/Desktop/binf_capstone/assembly_evaluation/quast_output"

parse_quast <- function(filepath) {
  df <- read.delim(filepath, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  sample <- basename(dirname(filepath))
  sample <- str_remove(sample, "_genomic_quast$")

  metrics <- df[[1]]
  values <- df[[2]]
  names(values) <- metrics

  data.frame(
    Sample          = sample,
    Num_Contigs     = as.numeric(values["# contigs"]),
    Largest_Contig  = as.numeric(values["Largest contig"]),
    Total_Length_bp = as.numeric(values["Total length"]),
    GC_percent      = as.numeric(values["GC (%)"]),
    N50             = as.numeric(values["N50"]),
    L50             = as.numeric(values["L50"]),
    Ns_per_100kbp   = as.numeric(values["# N's per 100 kbp"]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# important to say ^report, other wise this will grab the transposed report too, and that will double the info per genome.
quast_files <- list.files(quast_dir, pattern = "^report\\.tsv",
                          recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
quast_files <- quast_files[str_count(quast_files, "/") == str_count(quast_dir, "/") + 2]
quast_df <- bind_rows(lapply(quast_files, parse_quast))

Combined Summary Table

summary_df <- full_join(busco_df, quast_df, by = "Sample") %>%
  arrange(Sample)

kable(summary_df, caption = "Combined BUSCO and QUAST metrics for all 13 genomes")

Completeness — BUSCO Plot

busco_long <- busco_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(BUSCO_Single, BUSCO_Duplicated, BUSCO_Fragmented, BUSCO_Missing),
               names_to = "Category", values_to = "Percentage") %>%
  mutate(Category = str_remove(Category, "BUSCO_"),
         Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Missing", "Fragmented", "Duplicated", "Single")))

busco_colors <- c(
  "Single" = "#56B4E9",
  "Duplicated" = "#F0E442",
  "Fragmented" = "#E69F00",
  "Missing" = "#D55E00"
)

ggplot(busco_long, aes(x = Sample, y = Percentage, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = busco_colors,
                    breaks = c("Single", "Duplicated", "Fragmented", "Missing")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "BUSCO Completeness Assessment",
       subtitle = "bacteria_odb10 | 124 BUSCOs",
       x = "Assembly", y = "Percentage of BUSCOs (%)", fill = "Category") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

Contiguity — QUAST Plots

N50 per Genome

quast_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Sample, N50), y = N50 / 1e6)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#0072B2", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "N50 per Assembly",
       x = "Assembly", y = "N50 (Mbp)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

Number of Contigs per Genome

quast_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Sample, -Num_Contigs), y = Num_Contigs)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#009E73", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Number of Contigs per Assembly",
       x = "Assembly", y = "Number of Contigs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

QC Flags

Genomes flagged if BUSCO completeness < 90% or number of contigs > 100:

flags <- summary_df %>%
  filter(BUSCO_Complete < 90 | Num_Contigs > 100)

if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
  cat("All genomes passed QC thresholds.\n")
} else {
  kable(flags[, c("Sample", "BUSCO_Complete", "Num_Contigs")],
        caption = "Genomes flagged for low completeness or high fragmentation")
}
